description: This file defines the ReportToAccessStrategy class, which extends AccessStrategy and implements access control logic based on employee hierarchy (subordinates and superiors) within the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves access data related to employees' reporting relationships.

classes.name: ReportToAccessStrategy
classes.description: A class that provides access control based on employee reporting structure within the HR management system.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Retrieves access entities related to an employee's subordinates and supervisors.
